dz: 加泰罗尼亚法院最后一届历史会议加泰罗尼亚公国议会结束. 法院通过的加泰罗尼亚宪法现代化,旨在改善对个人,政治和经济权利的保障(如通信保密等).
de: The last session of history of the Catalan Courts, the parliament of the Principality of Catalonia, ends. Catalonia's constitutional modernisation passed by the Courts aims to improve the guarantee of individual, political and economic rights (such as the secrecy of correspondence).

de: The Long Parliament presents the Humble Petition and Advice offering Oliver Cromwell the British throne, which he eventually declines.

dz: 阿拉贡的斐迪南二世和卡斯蒂利亚的伊莎贝拉一世在"西班牙驱逐犹太人法令"上签字,命令其王国中的所有犹太人要么皈依基督教,要么出走.
de: Ferdinand II of Aragon and Isabella I of Castile sign the Edict of Expulsion of the Jews from Spain, ordering all Jews in their kingdoms to either convert to Christianity or leave the country.

de: Pope Gregory X calls for a General Church Council to discuss reunion of Churches, Crusade to the Holy Land and Church reform.

te: A conspiracy against Saladin, aiming to restore the Fatimid Caliphate, is revealed in Cairo, involving senior figures o…
dz: 在开罗揭露了一场反对萨拉丁的阴谋,其目的是恢复法蒂米德哈里发,前法蒂米德政权的高级人物和诗人乌马拉·雅马尼也参与了这场阴谋. 现代历史学家怀疑官方来源所报道的阴谋的程度和危险,但其头目会在随后的几周被公开处决.
de: A conspiracy against Saladin, aiming to restore the Fatimid Caliphate, is revealed in Cairo, involving senior figures of the former Fatimid regime and the poet Umara al-Yamani. Modern historians doubt the extent and danger of the conspiracy reported in official sources, but its ringleaders will be publicly executed over the following weeks.

dz: 克莱尔沃的伯纳德在韦兹莱的田野上宣讲他著名的布道，敦促第二次十字军东征的必要性。路易七世出席并加入十字军东征。
de: Bernard of Clairvaux preaches his famous sermon in a field at Vézelay, urging the necessity of a Second Crusade. Louis VII is present, and joins the Crusade.

t: 与妻子米内尔维纳离婚后,君士坦丁与已退休的罗马皇帝马克西米安之女福斯塔结婚.
te: After divorcing his wife Minervina, Constantine marries Fausta, daughter of the retired Roman emperor Maximian.
dz: 与妻子米内尔维纳离婚后,君士坦丁与已退休的罗马皇帝马克西米安之女福斯塔结婚.
de: After divorcing his wife Minervina, Constantine marries Fausta, daughter of the retired Roman emperor Maximian.
